# OpenShell Dashboard Helm chart

<!-- Generated by helm-docs; edit README.md.gotmpl and values.yaml, then run `make helm-docs` -->

Deploys one stateless dashboard Deployment alongside an [OpenShell gateway](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/tree/main/deploy/helm/openshell). Only the oauth2-proxy sidecar is exposed. The BFF binds `127.0.0.1:8080`; the Service and NetworkPolicy expose only proxy port 4180. The chart creates no gateway certificates, database, cluster RBAC, or certgen job.

## Install

Install the upstream gateway into the **same namespace**, release name `openshell` (or override `gateway.serviceName` / `gateway.url`). Set `server.oidc.issuer`, `server.oidc.audience`, `server.oidc.rolesClaim`, `server.oidc.adminRole`, and `server.oidc.caConfigMapName` there to the same values as `oidc.*` here. For OpenShift, layer `ci/values-openshift-scc.yaml` and `ci/values-route-edge.yaml`. Replace sample issuer and host before installing.

Create a confidential client `openshell-dashboard` at the same IdP with `https://<dashboard-host>/oauth2/callback` as its redirect URI. oauth2-proxy forwards its **access token** to the gateway. That token's `aud` must contain gateway `server.oidc.audience` (`openshell-cli` by default); chart value `oidc.audience` documents this expectation but does not alter tokens. With API-client roles in the token, Keycloak's built-in Audience Resolve mapper can add that client to `aud`; realm-role-only or authentication-only setups need an explicit audience mapper. Check the access token, not the ID token.
Provision the Secret outside Helm (the cookie secret must be a random 32-byte value):

```sh
kubectl -n openshell create secret generic openshell-dashboard-oidc \
  --from-literal=client-secret='<client secret>' \
  --from-literal=cookie-secret='<random cookie secret>'

helm upgrade --install openshell-dashboard ./deploy/helm/openshell-dashboard \
  -n openshell -f ./deploy/helm/openshell-dashboard/ci/values-openshift-scc.yaml \
  -f ./deploy/helm/openshell-dashboard/ci/values-route-edge.yaml \
  --set oidc.issuer=https://keycloak.apps.example.com/realms/openshell \
  --set openshiftRoute.host=dashboard.apps.example.com \
  --set dashboard.image.tag=<image tag> \
  --set oidc.adminRole=openshell-admin
```

### Configuring your installation
Apply a values file. For an example that uses openshift routes and keycloak:

```yaml
gateway:
  url: grpcs://<gateway-service>.namespace-a.svc.cluster.local:<port>
  caSecretName: <gateway-ca-secret>
oidc:
  provider: keycloak-oidc
  issuer: https://keycloak.example.com/realms/openshell
  clientId: openshell-dashboard
  existingSecret: openshell-dashboard-oidc
  adminRole: openshell-admin
  allowedRoles:
    - openshell-api:openshell-admin
    - openshell-api:openshell-user
  scope: openid profile email
  codeChallengeMethod: S256
authProxy:
  cookie:
    name: _oauth2_proxy
    sameSite: lax
openshiftRoute:
  enabled: true
  host: openshell-dashboard.example.com
```

The default `oidc.provider=oidc` works with any compatible OIDC issuer. Use `oidc.allowedGroups` for group restrictions supported by the provider. For Keycloak client/realm role checks, set `oidc.provider=keycloak-oidc` and `oidc.allowedRoles` (roles are alternatives). Other issuer-specific settings such as `oidc.scope` and `oidc.codeChallengeMethod` are optional; the generic OIDC scope defaults to `openid email profile`.

`oidc.clientIdSecretKey` reads the client ID from the same existing Secret and takes precedence over `oidc.clientId`. To use a non-Keycloak issuer, keep `oidc.provider=oidc` and omit `oidc.allowedRoles`. Edge Routes terminate TLS before oauth2-proxy; keep `authProxy.forceHTTPS=false` (default), with secure cookies enabled. Set `authProxy.forceHTTPS=true` only if proxy itself has HTTPS enabled via `authProxy.tls.secretName`.

Gateway TLS CA mounts `openshell-client-tls` key `ca.crt`, created by upstream certgen or cert-manager. Gateway URLs accept `grpcs://` or `https://` for TLS and `grpc://` or `http://` for plaintext. Only set `gateway.clientCertSecretName` if the gateway requires mTLS without OIDC, and restrict proxy users with `oidc.allowedGroups` or `oidc.allowedRoles`. For `server.disableTls=true`, use `ci/values-tls-disabled.yaml` (no CA); browser ingress still needs HTTPS. The default dashboard image uses `quay.io/gkrumbach07/openshell-dashboard:<appVersion>`; the upstream oauth2-proxy image is pinned to `v7.15.2` until downstream image choice is settled. Override images by tag or immutable digest for releases.

The `keycloak`, `route-edge`, `route-reencrypt`, `gateway-api`, `mtls-client-cert`, `tls-disabled`, and `openshift-scc` overlays in `ci/` are renderable examples. Replace example hostnames, the reencrypt destination CA, and provision all referenced Secrets/ConfigMaps. For reencrypt, `authProxy.tls.secretName` supplies a proxy server certificate for the Route host; the Route validates it with `destinationCACertificate`. HTTPRoute forwards HTTP to proxy and needs a TLS-terminating Gateway for secure cookies. Preserve Host and WebSocket upgrade headers at any controller. The Route sets `timeout` to 300s and `timeout-tunnel` to 1h for terminal sessions.

NetworkPolicy allows ingress to the proxy port from `openshift-ingress` by default. When HTTPRoute is enabled, its Gateway namespace is selected instead. Override `networkPolicy.ingressNamespace` if the **data-plane proxy pods** live elsewhere; some ingress controllers use hostNetwork/node IPs and need cluster-specific policy configuration. Direct BFF access bypasses authentication; do not expose pod port 8080. Dashboard exec probes run the binary's `--healthcheck` against loopback; proxy HTTP probes use `/ping`. Override `probes.*.dashboardCommand` for downstream images with another binary path. `gateway.preflight.enabled=true` checks an existing gateway Service on live Helm installations; keep it false for `helm template`.

Chart version and appVersion start at `0.0.0`; release CI stamps both with the released image version and publishes `oci://ghcr.io/gkrumbach07/openshell-dashboard/helm-chart/openshell-dashboard`. Stable OCI versions are never overwritten; installers pin chart version and image digest separately. CI also publishes a floating `0.0.0-dev` chart whose appVersion is the matching `sha-<commit>` image tag. For downstream registry mirrors, override `global.image.registry` and each component repository/digest.

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| affinity | object | `{}` | Affinity. |
| authProxy.apiRoutes | list | `["^/api/"]` | API path patterns that return HTTP 401 instead of redirecting to the identity provider on an expired session. |
| authProxy.cookie.name | string | `"_oauth2_proxy"` | Session cookie name; use a distinct name when dashboards share a hostname. |
| authProxy.cookie.refresh | string | `"2m"` | Interval for refreshing the access token; set below the issuer's access-token lifetime. Empty disables refresh. |
| authProxy.cookie.sameSite | string | `"lax"` | Session cookie SameSite attribute (lax, strict, none, or empty to omit). |
| authProxy.extraArgs | list | `[]` | Additional oauth2-proxy flags, appended after chart-generated arguments. |
| authProxy.forceHTTPS | bool | `false` | Force HTTP requests to HTTPS at the proxy. Requires authProxy.tls.secretName; leave false behind TLS-terminating ingress. |
| authProxy.image.digest | string | `""` | Proxy image digest; takes precedence over tag. |
| authProxy.image.pullPolicy | string | `nil` | Proxy pull policy; null uses global.image.pullPolicy. |
| authProxy.image.registry | string | `""` | oauth2-proxy registry; empty uses global.image.registry. |
| authProxy.image.repository | string | `"oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy"` | oauth2-proxy repository. Replace with approved downstream image if needed. |
| authProxy.image.tag | string | `"v7.15.2"` | Proxy image tag; pinned until proxy version is tied to chart releases. |
| authProxy.port | int | `4180` | Port on which oauth2-proxy listens. |
| authProxy.resources | object | `{}` | Resource requests/limits for oauth2-proxy. |
| authProxy.tls.secretName | string | `""` | Secret with tls.crt/tls.key for HTTPS proxy backend (required for Route reencrypt). |
| authProxy.upstreamTimeout | string | `"120s"` | Maximum amount of time the proxy will wait for a response from the upstream. |
| authProxy.whitelistDomains | list | `[]` | Allowed redirect domains (including IdP sign-out redirects); prefix with . or *. to allow subdomains. |
| autoscaling.enabled | bool | `false` | Create autoscaling/v2 HPA (CPU/memory metrics need requests or limits on both containers). |
| autoscaling.maxReplicas | int | `4` | Maximum replicas. |
| autoscaling.minReplicas | int | `1` | Minimum replicas. |
| autoscaling.targetCPUUtilizationPercentage | int | `80` | CPU target utilization (null to disable). |
| autoscaling.targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage | string | `nil` | Memory target utilization (null to disable). |
| dashboard.image.digest | string | `""` | Dashboard image digest; takes precedence over tag. |
| dashboard.image.pullPolicy | string | `nil` | Dashboard pull policy; null uses global.image.pullPolicy. |
| dashboard.image.registry | string | `""` | Dashboard image registry; empty uses global.image.registry. |
| dashboard.image.repository | string | `"gkrumbach07/openshell-dashboard"` | Dashboard image repository. |
| dashboard.image.tag | string | `""` | Dashboard image tag; empty uses global.image.tag then Chart.appVersion. |
| dashboard.logoutURL | string | `"/oauth2/sign_out"` | Sign-out endpoint exposed by oauth2-proxy. |
| dashboard.port | int | `8080` | Dashboard container port (loopback only; never exposed via Service). |
| fullnameOverride | string | `""` | Full resource name override. |
| gateway.caKey | string | `"ca.crt"` | CA key in the Secret. |
| gateway.caSecretName | string | `"openshell-client-tls"` | TLS CA Secret in the release namespace. Empty only with a plaintext grpc:// or http:// gateway URL. |
| gateway.clientCertSecretName | string | `""` | Optional client cert Secret (tls.crt/tls.key), for mTLS-only gateways. With OIDC, the forwarded bearer token alone suffices. |
| gateway.preflight.enabled | bool | `false` | Check gateway Service exists via lookup (requires live cluster; disable for offline rendering). |
| gateway.serviceName | string | `"openshell"` | Upstream gateway Service fullname (default upstream helm install openshell). |
| gateway.tls.enabled | bool | `true` | Use grpcs:// for the derived gateway URL; disable only with gateway.caSecretName empty. |
| gateway.url | string | `""` | Gateway gRPC URL (grpcs:// or https:// for TLS; grpc:// or http:// for plaintext). Empty derives scheme from gateway.tls.enabled and uses <serviceName>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:8080. |
| global.image.pullPolicy | string | `"IfNotPresent"` | Shared image pull policy. |
| global.image.registry | string | `"quay.io"` | Shared image registry; per-component registry overrides it. |
| global.image.tag | string | `""` | Shared image tag; defaults to Chart.appVersion when empty. |
| httpRoute.annotations | object | `{}` | HTTPRoute annotations. |
| httpRoute.enabled | bool | `false` | Create a Gateway API HTTPRoute to the proxy Service. |
| httpRoute.gateway.className | string | `"eg"` | GatewayClass for created Gateway. |
| httpRoute.gateway.create | bool | `false` | Create a Gateway in the release namespace; else use an existing one. |
| httpRoute.gateway.listener.allowedRoutes | string | `"Same"` | Allowed route namespaces: Same or All. |
| httpRoute.gateway.listener.port | int | `443` | Listener port. |
| httpRoute.gateway.listener.protocol | string | `"HTTPS"` | Listener protocol: HTTPS (recommended) or HTTP behind a separate trusted TLS terminator. |
| httpRoute.gateway.listener.tls.certificateRefs | list | `[]` | TLS Secret refs in Gateway namespace, required when creating HTTPS Gateway. |
| httpRoute.gateway.name | string | `""` | Gateway resource name; empty uses dashboard fullname. |
| httpRoute.gateway.namespace | string | `""` | Existing Gateway namespace; empty uses release namespace. |
| httpRoute.gateway.sectionName | string | `""` | Listener name when attaching to an existing Gateway; omitted by default unless this chart creates it. |
| httpRoute.hostnames | list | `[]` | Public hostnames; first hostname supplies callback URL if redirectURL is empty. |
| imagePullSecrets | list | `[]` | Image pull secrets for the dashboard pod. |
| nameOverride | string | `"openshell-dashboard"` | Resource name override; pod identity label remains openshell-dashboard. |
| networkPolicy.enabled | bool | `true` | Restrict ingress to the proxy port from the ingress controller namespace. |
| networkPolicy.ingressFrom | list | `[]` | Optional ingress peers replacing the default namespace selector (e.g. host-network routers or Gateway data-plane pods). |
| networkPolicy.ingressNamespace | string | `""` | Namespace of ingress data-plane pods. Empty uses openshift-ingress for Routes or httpRoute.gateway.namespace for HTTPRoute. |
| nodeSelector | object | `{}` | Node selector. |
| oidc.adminRole | string | `""` | Role name for admin access. Must be the same as the openshell gateway admin name. Defaults to "admin" |
| oidc.allowedGroups | list | `[]` | Allowed groups for generic OIDC or other providers; empty allows any authenticated user. |
| oidc.allowedRoles | list | `[]` | Allowed Keycloak roles (realm role or client:role); requires provider=keycloak-oidc. Multiple roles are alternatives. |
| oidc.audience | string | `"openshell-api"` | Expected audience claim for the API resource server. IdP must add it to token aud. Purely informational. |
| oidc.caConfigMapName | string | `""` | ConfigMap with ca.crt to trust private issuer TLS (also set on gateway). |
| oidc.clientId | string | `"openshell-dashboard"` | OAuth2-proxy OIDC client ID. |
| oidc.clientIdSecretKey | string | `""` | Optional key in oidc.existingSecret holding client ID; when set, takes precedence over oidc.clientId. |
| oidc.codeChallengeMethod | string | `""` | PKCE challenge method (e.g. S256); empty disables PKCE for providers that do not support it. |
| oidc.existingSecret | string | `"openshell-dashboard-oidc"` | Existing Secret containing keys client-secret and cookie-secret. |
| oidc.issuer | string | `""` | OIDC issuer URL (e.g. https://keycloak.example.com/realms/openshell) |
| oidc.provider | string | `"oidc"` | oauth2-proxy provider (oidc for generic OIDC, keycloak-oidc for Keycloak role filtering). |
| oidc.redirectURL | string | `""` | Full public callback URL; required when host is dynamically allocated. Empty derives from Route/HTTPRoute host. |
| oidc.rolesClaim | string | `""` | Same roles claim path as gateway server.oidc.rolesClaim (documented for installer parity and purely informaitonal). |
| oidc.scope | string | `""` | OAuth2 scopes; empty uses the provider default (openid email profile for generic OIDC). |
| openshiftRoute.annotations | object | `{"haproxy.router.openshift.io/timeout":"300s","haproxy.router.openshift.io/timeout-tunnel":"1h"}` | Route annotations; upstream e2e timeout values cover long-lived terminal WebSockets. |
| openshiftRoute.destinationCACertificate | string | `""` | CA PEM for reencrypt backend validation (requires a separate TLS-enabled proxy configuration). |
| openshiftRoute.enabled | bool | `false` | Create an edge/reencrypt OpenShift Route (never passthrough). |
| openshiftRoute.host | string | `""` | Public Route hostname; required unless oidc.redirectURL is set explicitly. |
| openshiftRoute.termination | string | `"edge"` | TLS termination at router: edge or reencrypt. Reencrypt requires proxy TLS and destination CA below. |
| podAnnotations | object | `{}` | Extra pod annotations. |
| podLabels | object | `{}` | Extra pod labels; cannot override identity/instance selector labels. |
| podLifecycle.terminationGracePeriodSeconds | int | `30` | Pod termination grace period in seconds. |
| podSecurityContext.fsGroup | int | `1000` | Pod fsGroup for vanilla Kubernetes; OpenShift overlay sets podSecurityContext to null. |
| probes.liveness.dashboardCommand | list | `["/usr/local/bin/openshell-dashboard","--healthcheck"]` | Dashboard exec command for liveness. |
| probes.liveness.failureThreshold | int | `3` | Liveness probe failure threshold. |
| probes.liveness.periodSeconds | int | `10` | Liveness probe period in seconds. |
| probes.readiness.dashboardCommand | list | `["/usr/local/bin/openshell-dashboard","--healthcheck"]` | Dashboard exec command for readiness. |
| probes.readiness.failureThreshold | int | `3` | Readiness probe failure threshold. |
| probes.readiness.periodSeconds | int | `5` | Readiness probe period in seconds. |
| probes.startup.dashboardCommand | list | `["/usr/local/bin/openshell-dashboard","--healthcheck"]` | Dashboard exec command; default calls the BFF's loopback self-check. Override for images with another binary path. |
| probes.startup.failureThreshold | int | `30` | Startup probe failure threshold (dashboard and proxy). |
| probes.startup.periodSeconds | int | `2` | Startup probe period in seconds. |
| replicaCount | int | `1` | Number of stateless dashboard pods (ignored when autoscaling is enabled). |
| resources | object | `{}` | Dashboard resource requests/limits. |
| securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation | bool | `false` | Disallow privilege escalation. |
| securityContext.capabilities.drop | list | `["ALL"]` | Drop all Linux capabilities. |
| securityContext.runAsNonRoot | bool | `true` | Require non-root containers. |

| serviceAccount.create | bool | `true` | Create a dedicated ServiceAccount. |
| serviceAccount.name | string | `""` | Existing ServiceAccount name if create=false. |
| tolerations | list | `[]` | Tolerations. |
